During the [[Imperial Era]], this model of [[freighter]] was widely used by many factions, primarily by cargo haulers and [[pirate]]s. ==Characteristics== ===Exterior and Hull=== [[File:YT-2400_light_freighter_schematics.jpg|thumb|left|The schematics of a YT-2400 light freighter]] The YT-2400 [[light freighter]] was a stock cargo hauler produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] (CEC) as a part of their [[YT-series]] line of [[starship]]s. The YT-2400 had the same basic disc-shaped hull most YT-series had, but was set apart by its tubular [[cockpit]] that was connected to the hull by two starboard bracing arms. Behind the cockpit was the ship's main [[escape pod]], capable of ferrying six passengers. Opposite the primary escape pod and inside the YT-2400's cargo area was a secondary escape pod. The YT-2400's hull was protected by reinforced bulkhead frames and double-armored plating. The [[freighter]] was 18.65 [[meter]]s in length and 28.5 meters in width. Despite sharing many parts with the CEC [[YT-1300 light freighter]], the YT-2400 was more compact and maneuverable, and could be easily operated by a single [[pilot]]. ===Armament=== A stock YT-2400 light freighter came equipped with dual [[laser cannon]]s mounted on [[Corellian]] [[1D servo turret]]s. The freighter was armed with 2 of these units, one dorsal and one ventral. The YT-2400 also had 13 weapon emplacement points built in for ease of modification. The stock configuration used 6 of these emplacements, leaving 7 free. ===Speed and energy=== The YT-2400 light freighter could reach [[Atmosphere|atmospheric]] speeds up to 800 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]]. The freighter came with a Class 2 [[hyperdrive]] and a Class 12 backup hyperdrive, both backed by a [[Navigation computer|Navicomputer]]. The standard YT-2400 was equipped with [[deflector shield]]s. Powering the freighter was a [[power core]] that output nearly twice the amount of other YT models. This extra energy allowed for oversized [[engine]]s and additional modifications. ===Storage and capacity=== A YT-2400 light freighter was manned by a crew of 3 and had room for 6 passengers. Crew quarters and living areas were located within the ship's bracing arms. Not as spacious as other YT-series models, the YT-2400 made up for this with it's ease of modification and extra cargo space; being able to haul 150 [[metric ton]]s worth. A new YT-2400 light freighter was worth 130,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], while a used was 32,000. ==Role==
[[File:YT-2400_light_freighter-SWC.png|thumb|right|250px|The mercenary Saponza used a YT-2400 to transport troops.]]
The YT-2400 light freighter was a compact starship used for hauling cargo and the [[transport]]ation of troops. ==History== The YT-2400 light freighter was developed and produced by [[Corellia]]n Engineering Corporation. CEC promoted their YT-2400 as having the best features of a YT-1300 light freighter, in a smaller, more compact design. Upon release CEC noted that customers preferred the [[SRB42 sublight engine|wide bar engine]] popularized by the YT-1300, which the YT-2400 lacked. Although CEC did not offer cylindrical engines as a standard option for the YT-2400, they did authorize the release of modification kits that enabled the installation of cylindrical engines. After unveiling the YT-2400, CEC discontinued their [[YT-2000 light freighter|YT-2000 transport]] model early, despite its good sales. ===Imperial Era=== {{Quote|Unidentified freighter, this is the freighter Slipknot. Looks like you're scorching out of here. Need any assistance?|Ensign Eli Vanto aboard the ''Slipknot'', contacting Nevil Cygni's Nomad ship|audio=ThisIsTheSlipknot-Thrawn.flac|[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']]}} [[File:Slipknot-Thrawn5.png|thumb|left|250px|YT-2400 freighter ''Slipknot'']] During the [[Batonn insurgency]], in the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Galactic Empire]], Imperial [[Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] and [[ensign]] [[Eli N. Vanto|Eli Vanto]] used a YT-2400 freighter[[Thrawn 4|''Thrawn'' 4]] known as the ''[[Slipknot]]'' to pose as weapons [[smuggler]]s in order to board [[Nevil Cygni]]'s [[Nomad (starship)|Nomad]] starship. The freighter was destroyed when the pair needed a distraction to escape the Nomad ship. ===Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire=== {{Quote|Ship needs a little work.''"
"''Try not to touch anything, it's organized the way we like it.''"
"''If you like a junk pile.|Sabine Wren and Gooti Terez aboard the YT-2400 light freighter ''Sato's Hammer''|audio=Ship_needs_a_little_work-SWR_S3E8.flac|}} The [[Wookiee]] [[Lohgarra]] captained a YT-2400 light freighter[[Lost Stars (webcomic)|''Lost Stars'' webcomic]] known as the ''[[Mighty Oak Apocalypse]]'' (often referred to as ''MOA''). In [[3 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' to [[3 BBY]]. Lohgarra agreed to transport [[Apprentice Legislator]]s [[Amilyn Holdo]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] aboard the ''MOA'' to the [[planet]] [[Pamarthe]].''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' Lohgarra and the ''MOA'' would later join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].''[[Lost Stars]]'' A [[Rebel cell/Canon|rebel cell]] known as [[Iron Squadron]] used the YT-2400 freighter ''[[Sato's Hammer]]'' as their home base. Once belonging to the famed [[Jun Sato]], the dilapidated ship served the young rebels well when it helped them [[Skirmish over Mykapo|damage]] an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|Imperial cruiser]]. Iron Squadron leader, [[Mart Mattin]], would later take ''Sato's Hammer'' and leave the Rebellion before eventually deciding to rejoin Iron Squadron.{{SWRMCite|35|A Youth Unpromising}} ===Galactic Civil War=== {{Quote|We've secured a less conspicuous transport.|Tula Markona to Luke Skywalker after stealing a YT-2400 light freighter|[[Star Wars (2015) 61|''Star Wars'' (2015) 61]]}} [[File:Outrider_canon.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Outrider'']] A YT-2400 light freighter known as the ''[[Outrider]]'' operated during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In [[1 BBY]]The ''Outrider'' is seen leaving [[Tatooine]] in {{Film|IV}}, which dates to [[1 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''. Therefore, the ''Outrider'' leaving Tatooine at that instance must have occurred in the same [[time]]. the ''Outrider'' left [[Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine]].{{Film|IV}}. A [[Unidentified YT-2400 light freighter (Clan Markona)|YT-2400 light freighter]] was held by the Galactic Empire at the [[Imperial Impound Yard]] on [[Novka]]. During a Rebel [[Attack on an Imperial Impound Yard|attack]] on the Impound yard the freighter was stolen by [[Tula Markona]] Rebel [[mercenary]] [[Saponza]] and [[Saponza's partner|his associate]] used at least one YT-2400 light freighter to [[Troop transport|transport]] troops to and from [[Saponza's homestead]]. A YT-2400 light freighter was present during the [[Battle of Hoth]].''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' In [[5 ABY]], Imperial defector [[Ralsius Paldora]] claimed that a YT-1300 light freighter's hyperdrive failed 1.22 more times than a YT-2400's.''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' While on the [[Entropian Hive]], [[New Republic]] [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] [[Yrica Quell]] witnessed a YT-2400 leaving the [[asteroid]] base. Quell likened the dented starship to one [[Yrica Quell's mother|her mother]] had flown.[[Alphabet Squadron (novel)|''Alphabet Squadron'']] ===Later history=== In [[35 ABY]],{{FilmDate|IX}} YT-2400 light freighters were part of a [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet]] assembled by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to assist the Resistance during the [[Battle of Exegol|battle]] against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] over the [[planet]] [[Exegol]].{{Film|IX}} ==Behind the scenes== ===Creation and development=== {{Quote|I took what I thought was unique about the Millennium Falcon, which is this kind of asymmetrical cockpit that is basically a sphere with two prongs on it, and played around with different variations on that theme.|Doug Chiang on the design of the YT-2400 light freighter|}} [[File:Outider-concept-art-SoSW-SotE.png|thumb|right|250px|Early concept art of the YT-2400 light freighter the ''Outrider'' by Kilian Plunkett (left), Jon Knoles (top right), and final concept art by Doug Chiang (bottom right)]] The YT-2400 light freighter (specifically, the ''Outrider''), was created for the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] multimedia project ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''.''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' Early concept art of the ''Outrider'' was created by game designer, lead artist and animator of the [[1996]] video game [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'']], [[Jon Knoles]].[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]] Another early design for the ship was created by artist [[Kilian Plunkett]]. Ultimately, the final design of the ''Outrider'' was provided by [[Lucasfilm]] concept art director [[Doug Chiang]]. Lucasfilm editor [[Allan Kausch]] provided Chiang with a basic outline on what the ''Outrider'' should look like; "comparable to the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''" but not too similar. Originally pincer-like in form, Chiang's ''Outrider'' design was finalized by [[1994]]. The "one-angle view" sketches were passed on to Jon Knoles, who then created schematics of the YT-2400 at various angles. The schematics were tweaked and tuned before the design was built as a computer model. According to [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]], Doug Chiang confirmed that the design for YT-2400 light freighter was originally created for the [[1997]] re-release of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which was in development at the same time as ''Shadows of the Empire'', and the design of the ship was repurposed as the ''Outrider''.{{SWYouTube|Gg6vtqWPh3c|Rebels Recon #3.06: Inside "Imperial Super Commandos" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-imperial-super-commandos}} The YT-2400 light freighter made its first [[canon]] appearance in the re-release of ''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'', where the ''Outrider'' is seen in the background taking off from Mos Eisley as [[Luke Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] arrive.{{Film|IV}} ===Continuity=== There is some discrepancy regarding the YT-2400's length. The [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' states that the YT-2400's length is 21 meters. However, the reference book ''[[YT-1300 Millennium Falcon Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' released later in 2018 claims that the YT-2400's length is 18.65 meters. As ''YT-1300 Corellian Freighter Owner's Workshop Manual'' is the most recent source, this article gives it precedence. The ''YT-1300 Corellian Freighter Owner's Workshop Manual'' also states that the YT-2400 light freighter was introduced after the release of the YT-2000 transport, and that the YT-2000 transport was created "during the period that the Rebel Alliance rose up against the Galactic Empire". However a YT-2400 light freighter is present in a panel of the [[2017]] comic book [[Darth Maul (2017) 2|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 2]] which takes place in [[33 BBY]], fourteen years before''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Darth Maul (2017) 2|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 2]] to [[33 BBY]]. the creation of the Galactic Empire.[[Darth Maul (2017) 2|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 2]] This article assumes that the YT-2400 light freighter's inclusion in ''Darth Maul Part II'' was an [[Wikipedia:Easter egg (media)|"Easter egg"]] inserted by the comic's illustrator, [[Luke Ross]], and not a canonical appearance. In the novels [[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']], ''[[Lost Stars]]'' and ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' the freighters ''Slipknot'' and ''Mighty Oak Apocalypse'' are never stated to be YT-2400 light freighters. They are only depicted as such in the comic book adaptation of ''Thrawn'', [[Star Wars: Thrawn (comic series)|''Star Wars: Thrawn'']], and the [[Wikipedia:Japan|Japanese]] [[Lost Stars (webcomic)|webcomic adaption of ''Lost Stars'']]. ===Non-canon history=== ====Disney Infinity 3.0==== The YT-2400 light freighter makes two appearances in the [[2015]] video game ''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''. In the ''Rise Against the Empire'' playset a YT-2400 is visible flying over Tatooine. In the ''The Force Awakens'' playset, after completing the mission "Blasting Pad," a YT-2400 will land near [[Takodana Castle]] while in free roam or during a mission.''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''
